immutableAuthoringPack.wholeChartSummary: 这张盘应先从整盘路由首先经过 MOON；紧密主要相位网络：JUPITER、NEPTUNE、SATURN、VENUS；四轴框定命盘如何进入现实与变得可见进入。这里的排序主题来自不同结构证据家族的整合，而不是逐星体目录。

coreThemes.headline: 整盘路由首先经过 MOON
coreThemes.summary: 在已选定的传统守护体系中，上升星座的守护星作为整盘层级的路由参照，用来显示命盘入口取向如何被导向；它不把该行星变成完整人格标签，也不把它当作命运控制者。 最终守护：MARS、SATURN。

coreThemes.headline: 四轴框定命盘如何进入现实与变得可见
coreThemes.summary: ASC 落在 CANCER：容纳方向。 MC 落在 ARIES：启动方向。 东方地平线升起点，用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境、如何被外界看见。它是象征性接口，不是固定人格事实。 上中天子午线点，用来组织公共方向、可见贡献与角色取向；它不保证事业地位或结果。

coreThemes.headline: 这张盘有分布背景，而不是一个“主导元素”捷径
coreThemes.summary: 元素以 WATER 为唯一最高计数（5/10）。 模式以 CARDINAL 为唯一最高计数（5/10）。 当某一元素在登记统计范围内拥有唯一最高计数时，可以称为“最具代表性的元素”。若并列就保持并列；两种结果都不能转成固定的心理主导标签。

text.en: The eastern horizon point used to organize how the chart meets immediate situations and becomes outwardly legible. It is a symbolic interface, not a fixed identity fact.
text.zh-Hans: 东方地平线升起点，用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境、如何被外界看见。它是象征性接口，不是固定人格事实。

text.en: The upper meridian point used to organize public direction, visible contribution and role orientation. It does not guarantee career status or outcomes.
text.zh-Hans: 上中天子午线点，用来组织公共方向、可见贡献与角色取向；它不保证事业地位或结果。

text.en: The lower meridian point used to organize private foundation, inner base and continuity of belonging. It does not establish family history or fate.
text.zh-Hans: 下中天子午线点，用来组织私人基础、内在根基与归属连续性；它不建立家庭历史或命运事实。

text.en: Under the selected traditional rulership school, the ruler of the Ascendant sign is used as a chart-level routing reference. It highlights where the chart’s entry orientation is routed, without making that planet a total personality label or fate controller.
text.zh-Hans: 在已选定的传统守护体系中，上升星座的守护星作为整盘层级的路由参照，用来显示命盘入口取向如何被导向；它不把该行星变成完整人格标签，也不把它当作命运控制者。

text.en: A house ruler links the sign on a calculated house cusp to that sign’s registered ruler. It is a structural route between a house domain and a planetary function, not a guarantee that events described by that house will occur.
text.zh-Hans: 宫位守护把实际计算宫头上的星座连接到该星座已登记的守护星，形成宫位领域与行星功能之间的结构路由；它不保证该宫位所涉及的事件一定发生。

text.en: A dispositor chain follows each planet’s sign ruler through the selected rulership system. The chain describes routing topology among planetary functions; chain length or position does not by itself establish strength, virtue, pathology or life outcome.
text.zh-Hans: 守护链按照已选定的守护体系，从每颗行星所在星座的守护星继续追踪。它描述行星功能之间的路由拓扑；链条长短或位置本身不代表强弱、优劣、病理或人生结果。

text.en: A final dispositor is a terminal self-ruling point in the selected dispositor chain, while a dispositor cycle is a closed routing loop. Both are chart-organization structures and must not be translated automatically into a single dominant planet or deterministic conclusion.
text.zh-Hans: 最终守护星是在已选守护链中回到自身守护的终点；守护循环则是闭合的路由环。两者都属于命盘组织结构，不得自动翻译成唯一主宰行星或决定论结论。

text.en: Element distribution counts the Fire, Earth, Air and Water signs occupied by the ten registered core planets under an unweighted scope. It describes representation in this selected set, not a complete personality composition.
text.zh-Hans: 元素分布以不加权方式统计十颗已登记核心行星分别落在火、土、风、水星座的数量。它描述这一选定范围内的代表性，不等同完整人格构成。

text.en: When one element has the unique highest count, it may be named the most represented element in the registered counting scope. A tie stays a tie; neither result is converted into a fixed psychological dominance label.
text.zh-Hans: 当某一元素在登记统计范围内拥有唯一最高计数时，可以称为“最具代表性的元素”。若并列就保持并列；两种结果都不能转成固定的心理主导标签。

text.en: Modality distribution counts Cardinal, Fixed and Mutable signs across the same ten-planet unweighted scope. It describes how the chart’s registered planetary positions are distributed across these directional modes, not a behavioral diagnosis.
text.zh-Hans: 模式分布在同一十行星不加权范围内统计基本、固定与变动星座的数量，用来描述已登记行星位置如何分布在这些方向模式中，而不是行为诊断。

text.en: A unique modality count leader may be reported as the most represented modality in the selected scope. The system preserves tied leaders and does not infer rigidity, instability, initiative or any other trait from count alone.
text.zh-Hans: 某一模式若在选定范围内拥有唯一最高计数，可以报告为“最具代表性的模式”。系统保留并列领先，不会只凭计数推断僵化、不稳定、主动性或其他人格特质。

text.en: Applying means the measured orb is decreasing under the registered short numerical probe using the two bodies’ longitudinal speeds. It describes aspect geometry at the birth moment and does not provide an event date or guarantee increasing real-world intensity.
text.zh-Hans: 入相表示按照两颗星体的黄经速度进行已登记的短时数值探测时，相位容许度正在缩小。它描述出生时刻的相位几何，不提供事件日期，也不保证现实强度一定增加。

text.en: Separating means the measured orb is increasing under the same registered short numerical probe. It is a geometric state classification, not evidence that a life situation is fading or has already happened.
text.zh-Hans: 出相表示在同一已登记短时数值探测下，相位容许度正在扩大。它只是几何状态分类，不代表某个生活情境正在减弱或已经发生。

requests.instructions: Write complete differentiated longform customer sections SEC-01, SEC-02, SEC-03. Return sectionManuscripts with sectionId, title, text, sourceThemeRefs and sourceRouteRefs. Explain whole-chart relationships using only supplied source evidence. Do not include internal codes in customer text. Explain rulership and the aspect cluster fully in SEC-01/SEC-02; later sections apply these without repeating the full explanation. No generic horoscope, notes-only output, invented circumstances, guarantees, or diagnoses. No timing authority: write structural adaptation without dated predictions. No reality context: SEC-08 must use structural integration; do not claim actual current circumstances.

text.zh-Hans: 东方地平线升起点，用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境、如何被外界看见。它是象征性接口，不是固定人格事实。

text.en: The upper meridian point used to organize public direction, visible contribution and role orientation. It does not guarantee career status or outcomes.
text.zh-Hans: 上中天子午线点，用来组织公共方向、可见贡献与角色取向；它不保证事业地位或结果。

text.en: The western horizon point used to organize one-to-one encounter and reciprocal engagement. It does not describe another person as a fixed type.
text.zh-Hans: 西方地平线下降点，用来组织一对一相遇与互惠互动；它不把他人定义成固定类型。

text.en: The lower meridian point used to organize private foundation, inner base and continuity of belonging. It does not establish family history or fate.
text.zh-Hans: 下中天子午线点，用来组织私人基础、内在根基与归属连续性；它不建立家庭历史或命运事实。

text.en: Under the selected traditional rulership school, the ruler of the Ascendant sign is used as a chart-level routing reference. It highlights where the chart’s entry orientation is routed, without making that planet a total personality label or fate controller.
text.zh-Hans: 在已选定的传统守护体系中，上升星座的守护星作为整盘层级的路由参照，用来显示命盘入口取向如何被导向；它不把该行星变成完整人格标签，也不把它当作命运控制者。

text.en: A house ruler links the sign on a calculated house cusp to that sign’s registered ruler. It is a structural route between a house domain and a planetary function, not a guarantee that events described by that house will occur.
text.zh-Hans: 宫位守护把实际计算宫头上的星座连接到该星座已登记的守护星，形成宫位领域与行星功能之间的结构路由；它不保证该宫位所涉及的事件一定发生。

text.en: A dispositor chain follows each planet’s sign ruler through the selected rulership system. The chain describes routing topology among planetary functions; chain length or position does not by itself establish strength, virtue, pathology or life outcome.
text.zh-Hans: 守护链按照已选定的守护体系，从每颗行星所在星座的守护星继续追踪。它描述行星功能之间的路由拓扑；链条长短或位置本身不代表强弱、优劣、病理或人生结果。

text.en: A final dispositor is a terminal self-ruling point in the selected dispositor chain, while a dispositor cycle is a closed routing loop. Both are chart-organization structures and must not be translated automatically into a single dominant planet or deterministic conclusion.
text.zh-Hans: 最终守护星是在已选守护链中回到自身守护的终点；守护循环则是闭合的路由环。两者都属于命盘组织结构，不得自动翻译成唯一主宰行星或决定论结论。

text.en: Element distribution counts the Fire, Earth, Air and Water signs occupied by the ten registered core planets under an unweighted scope. It describes representation in this selected set, not a complete personality composition.
text.zh-Hans: 元素分布以不加权方式统计十颗已登记核心行星分别落在火、土、风、水星座的数量。它描述这一选定范围内的代表性，不等同完整人格构成。

text.en: When one element has the unique highest count, it may be named the most represented element in the registered counting scope. A tie stays a tie; neither result is converted into a fixed psychological dominance label.
text.zh-Hans: 当某一元素在登记统计范围内拥有唯一最高计数时，可以称为“最具代表性的元素”。若并列就保持并列；两种结果都不能转成固定的心理主导标签。

text.en: Modality distribution counts Cardinal, Fixed and Mutable signs across the same ten-planet unweighted scope. It describes how the chart’s registered planetary positions are distributed across these directional modes, not a behavioral diagnosis.
text.zh-Hans: 模式分布在同一十行星不加权范围内统计基本、固定与变动星座的数量，用来描述已登记行星位置如何分布在这些方向模式中，而不是行为诊断。

text.en: A unique modality count leader may be reported as the most represented modality in the selected scope. The system preserves tied leaders and does not infer rigidity, instability, initiative or any other trait from count alone.
text.zh-Hans: 某一模式若在选定范围内拥有唯一最高计数，可以报告为“最具代表性的模式”。系统保留并列领先，不会只凭计数推断僵化、不稳定、主动性或其他人格特质。

text.en: Applying means the measured orb is decreasing under the registered short numerical probe using the two bodies’ longitudinal speeds. It describes aspect geometry at the birth moment and does not provide an event date or guarantee increasing real-world intensity.
text.zh-Hans: 入相表示按照两颗星体的黄经速度进行已登记的短时数值探测时，相位容许度正在缩小。它描述出生时刻的相位几何，不提供事件日期，也不保证现实强度一定增加。

text.en: Separating means the measured orb is increasing under the same registered short numerical probe. It is a geometric state classification, not evidence that a life situation is fading or has already happened.
text.zh-Hans: 出相表示在同一已登记短时数值探测下，相位容许度正在扩大。它只是几何状态分类，不代表某个生活情境正在减弱或已经发生。

Explain whole-chart relationships using only supplied source evidence. Do not include internal codes in customer text. Explain rulership and the aspect cluster fully in SEC-01/SEC-02; later sections apply these without repeating the full explanation. No generic horoscope, notes-only output, invented circumstances, guarantees, or diagnoses. No timing authority: write structural adaptation without dated predictions. No reality context: SEC-08 must use structural integration; do not claim actual current circumstances.

SUN.functionDefinition: 集中连续性、核心一致性与系统层级的自我参照，不赋予身份或命运。
SUN.directionDefinition: 将运动导向集中、深入、绑定与转化压力。
SUN.domainDefinition: 关于创造、实验、游戏、生成性输出与可见表达的现实领域。

MOON.functionDefinition: 记录调节、反应节律、保留与适应模式，不断言人格。
MOON.directionDefinition: 将运动导向比较、分支、交换与信息连接。
MOON.domainDefinition: 关于后台过程、退隐、结束、恢复、渗透与未被看见负荷的现实领域。

MERCURY.functionDefinition: 组织差异辨识、交换、比较与信息传递。
MERCURY.directionDefinition: 将运动导向集中、深入、绑定与转化压力。
MERCURY.domainDefinition: 关于创造、实验、游戏、生成性输出与可见表达的现实领域。

VENUS.functionDefinition: 组织价值判断、选择性吸引、偏好一致性与交换条件。
VENUS.directionDefinition: 将运动导向排序、制度化、责任与耐久结构。
VENUS.domainDefinition: 关于维护、日常流程、服务、负荷、调整与运行健康的现实领域。

MARS.functionDefinition: 组织定向用力、动员、分离、边界主张与即时行动。
MARS.directionDefinition: 将运动导向集中、深入、绑定与转化压力。
MARS.domainDefinition: 关于根基、私域基础、庇护、承继基础与内部锚定的现实领域。

JUPITER.functionDefinition: 组织范围扩展、综合、机会扫描与情境整合。
JUPITER.directionDefinition: 将运动导向容纳、保护、记忆与有边界的连续。
JUPITER.domainDefinition: 关于后台过程、退隐、结束、恢复、渗透与未被看见负荷的现实领域。

SATURN.functionDefinition: 组织限制、排序、责任、承重结构与长期稳定。
SATURN.directionDefinition: 将运动导向排序、制度化、责任与耐久结构。
SATURN.domainDefinition: 关于维护、日常流程、服务、负荷、调整与运行健康的现实领域。

URANUS.functionDefinition: 组织不连续、分化、新变异与打破既有模式的转折。
URANUS.directionDefinition: 将运动导向排序、制度化、责任与耐久结构。
URANUS.domainDefinition: 关于维护、日常流程、服务、负荷、调整与运行健康的现实领域。

NEPTUNE.functionDefinition: 组织渗透、扩散、模糊与情境融合，不把不确定性当作事实。
NEPTUNE.directionDefinition: 将运动导向排序、制度化、责任与耐久结构。
NEPTUNE.domainDefinition: 关于维护、日常流程、服务、负荷、调整与运行健康的现实领域。
